# Sven Ahrens

> Consumer growth and monetization leader based in Berlin. Eight years at Spotify (2016 to 2024), the last three as Director of Global Growth, where his team drove more than 60% of Spotify's subscriber growth and was responsible for over $1B in subscription revenue. CEO of Yousician (2025 to 2026), the company behind Yousician and GuitarTuna, with more than 20 million monthly active users. Board Observer at Female Invest. Founder of Newconic Ventures. Open to board seats, advisory work and the right operating role, including full-time.

## Experience

- CEO, Yousician (2025 to 2026), Helsinki and Berlin.
- Board Observer, Female Invest (2024 to present), Copenhagen.
- Chief Growth Officer, Muse Group (2024), Berlin. Started the company-wide shift to an LTV-driven subscription model.
- Founder, Newconic Ventures (2019 to present), Berlin. Angel investing and advisory; advisor to Peloton, Knowunity and Kittl.
- Spotify (2016 to 2024): Director, Global Growth (2021 to 2024); Associate Director, Subscriptions Europe (2018 to 2021); Head of Market Strategy and Operations (2017 to 2018); Global Market Operations Lead (2016).
- Consultant, Bain & Company (2012 to 2016), Munich. 2014 externship at SoundCloud.

## Ways to work together

- Operating role: full-time, interim or fractional leadership of growth, product, a region or a business unit.
- Running an existing team: resetting priorities, ownership and pace.
- Turnaround: short, intensive mandates where growth or monetization has stalled.
- Board: member or observer, focused on pricing, packaging and retention.
- Advisory: for founders and executives working through a specific decision.

## Areas

Subscription growth, monetization, pricing and packaging, conversion and trial design, retention and lifecycle, user acquisition, international expansion and localization, AI transformation, mobile consumer apps.

## Investments (Newconic Ventures)

Alba, Amie, Amino Collective (LP), Animoca Brands, Born, Butter (acquired by Miro), CareerOS, Dirigent, EPIX Sports, Flow AI, Heat, Mile, Informed, Komi, Litona, Melotech, Nemox, Peec, Petli (acquired by Agria), Protocol Health, Voicy.

## Also

- Builds his own AI products: https://www.trainwithkalle.com and https://www.trainingzones.app
- Languages: German (native), English, Spanish, Portuguese.
- Education: Stockholm School of Economics; ESADE Business School.
